items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Chad Rene was another good man.

ctx.x: And you remember how he sounded and how he played?

Oh, yeah, he was powerful, you know. He had plenty of power, you know. He had a good style, you know, and bruised and all that stuff. But as far as anything else, there was nothing to it, you know. And just like all those other boys, I betty was a good man too. Chad Rene was another good man. They had good potentialities, but they never did develop them, you understand? They never did study, you see. They had the lip and everything. They made fine musicians up there to study, but they just went on playing, that's…
What about Bolden? Does anybody who's made records or who's around today play anything like him?
